title: Keith & Plummer Store before 1907 fire. Behind was a cheese factory attached by planks
description: Keith & Plummer was owned by Webster Keith and Amasa Plummer, who became business partners after working in the school system; Keith as a teacher and Plummer as a principal. Together, they opened a general store offering furniture, groceries, clothing, china, and housewares, as well as bulk products such as flour, pickles, molasses, and nails. The store also featured furrier and millinery departments. Behind the building stood a cheese factory. They built an additional building to rent to various businesses, including Baird’s fruit stand, Simm’s tinsmith shop, and a confectionery shop.
